outline: 1844 Finding Unknown Sides Given the Area

examples.solution_text:
The height is $4\text{ m}$: it meets the extension of the $9\text{ m}$ base at a right angle.

$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=9\times4\\ &=36\text{ m}^{2}\end{align*}$

The $6\text{ cm}$ vertical base has a matching horizontal height of $4\text{ cm}$. The $5\text{ cm}$ slanted side is not used.

$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=6\times4\\ &=24\text{ cm}^{2}\end{align*}$

examples.question_text: A parallelogram has a base of $160\text{ mm}$ and a perpendicular height of $7\text{ cm}$. Find its area in $\text{mm}^{2}$.
examples.solution_text:
Convert the height to millimetres before multiplying.

$7\text{ cm}=70\text{ mm}$

$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=160\times70\\ &=11\,200\text{ mm}^{2}\end{align*}$

examples.question_text: A wall in the shape of a parallelogram has a base of $20\text{ m}$ and a perpendicular height of $6\text{ m}$. Each litre of paint covers $5\text{ m}^{2}$ and costs $\$15$. Find the cost of painting the wall.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=20\times6\\ &=120\text{ m}^{2}\end{align*}$

Paint needed: $120\div5=24$ litres.

Cost: $24\times15=\$360$.

examples.derivation: The diagram has base 12 cm, perpendicular height 4 cm and slanted side sqrt(3² + 4²) = 5 cm. Translating the cut triangle 12 coordinate units right produces the depicted 12-by-4 rectangle without gaps or overlaps. Area = 12 × 4 = 48 cm².
The external perpendicular height is 4 m and the base remains 9 m. The slanted side is sqrt(3² + 4²) = 5 m. Area = 9 × 4 = 36 m².
The vertical base is 6 cm and the horizontal perpendicular distance between the vertical sides is 4 cm. The slanted side is sqrt(4² + 3²) = 5 cm. Area = 6 × 4 = 24 cm².
7 cm = 70 mm. Using common length units, area = 160 × 70 = 11,200 mm². A diagram is unnecessary for the explicitly stated base and perpendicular height.
Wall area = 20 × 6 = 120 m². Paint needed = 120 ÷ 5 = 24 litres. Cost = 24 × $15 = $360.
